newsitem.title: USA: Network Trade says Ingram suit to proceed.
newsitem.headline: Network Trade says Ingram suit to proceed.

text.p: Network Trade Center, a business software distributor, said Friday that it won a round in federal court allowing the company to proceed with its lawsuit against Ingram Micro Inc, its largest vendor.
Network Trade sued Ingram, a computer distributor, alleging breach of contract and unfair trade practices. The lawsuit was filed in U.S. District Court in Utah.
Network Trade accuses Ingram of wrongfully refusing to honor a written, confirmed purchase order covering millions of dollars of software products.
The lawsuit also accuses the company of discriminating in price between different purchasers of software of like grade and quality.
Network Trade said in a statement that it estimated the alleged practice cost it "tens of millions of dollars."
Network Trade said the court has rejected several motions filed by Ingram seeking to set aside the lawsuit.
Ingram officials could not immediately be reached for comment.
